title: DEBRISVERSE
description:
Notice Regarding System EnvironmentDEBRISVERSE includes visual effects and puzzles that utilize features of the Windows OS environment.
For the best and intended experience, playing on a Windows PC is strongly recommended.
(Note: On non-Windows platforms, such as Steam Deck, certain effects or puzzles may not function as intended.)

План развитияMassive Free Update: Sept 2026!! We will continue to evaluate ongoing updates and improvements based on player feedback.[July 29, 2026]• DEBRISVERSE Official Release

[Scheduled for September 2026]Major Free UpdateHigh-Difficulty End-Game Content: "Mega Debris Rush (Tentative Title)"

More details will be revealed soon.

[Future Expansion Concepts (Release Date & Implementation TBD)]We are currently evaluating the following potential features:
(Note: These are not guaranteed updates. Implementation and final specifications will be determined based on player feedback and ongoing development status.)

• Planetary Development: Invest funds to restore environments and gather specialized upgrade materials.

• Cockpit Customization: Decorative features to personalize your cockpit space.

• Codex / Encyclopedia: A dedicated feature to visualize collections and track in-game achievements

Об игре--- That debt is a trap.Welcome to DEBRISVERSE.
From the cockpit of your retro-futuristic spaceship, your mission is to crush endless space debris and pay off an astronomical debt of $100 million. B.R.I.S. Corporation guarantees a clean and safe work environment. ...Unless you discover the "truth" behind B.R.I.S. Corp.

---------------------------------------------------------
[SYSTEM_WARNING: Unauthorized access detected] 
 Message from HR: Our work environment at B.R.I.S. Corp is perfectly sound. 
Rumors regarding "illegal modification patches" or an "endless debt loop" are entirely unfounded. 
All workers must return to their stations immediately and continue crushing debris. 

---------------------------------------------------------

Overwhelming Inflation and the Thrill of DestructionIntuitive controls and deep satisfaction: Select and instantly crush debris with your mouse. As your efficiency increases, the screen will be engulfed in a torrent of debris and an eruption of credits. Experience an addictive chain reaction of numerical inflation.

Choices that Accelerate "Destruction Efficiency"Roguelite Upgrades: Upon leveling up, you are presented with three random upgrade options. Will you maximize your attack power or increase your credit yield? Your choices dictate the speed of your repayment.

Investment or Repayment - Strategic Cash Flow: Spend your earned credits on immediate tool enhancements for overwhelming destructive power, or pay down your debt first to unlock discount perks for future tool upgrades. Your financial strategy determines how fast you clear your debt.

Expanding Hazardous Sectors: Based on your repayment track record, B.R.I.S. Corp will grant access to "Hazardous Sectors" filled with denser, massive debris, and issue permits to destroy dangerous targets. Venturing into harsher environments will explosively multiply your credit earnings.

Retrieving Unknown Technology: "Fragments"Lost technological remnants rarely emerge from the debris.
Collect these rare items to permanently boost your tools' performance and construct the ultimate destruction build.
A mysterious signal is emitting from the fragments, but there is currently no way to decipher it.

Repayment is Just the Beginning: "Meta-Elements" to Expose a Megacorp's Conspiracy Direct System Interference: Paying off the $100 million debt will not free you from labor. Do not overlook the noise and unnatural glitches appearing on your screen. Unconventional actions outside standard operating protocols, such as accessing hidden terminals, hold the key to your true objective.

7 Distinct Endings: The player's interference with the system and their choices serve as hidden flags, branching the narrative into 7 different endings. Destroy the megacorp's system and seize your true freedom.

A Nostalgic Work Environment Retro-futuristic UI: Experience a unique immersion as you work staring at old LCD monitors in your spaceship. A visual blend of pixel art and screen noise colors your solitary space labor. Your Partner "Bliss": The B.R.I.S. Corp mascot provides strictly administrative support for your labor.

---

description_short: That debt is a trap. DEBRISVERSE is a sci-fi incremental game where you crush space debris. Upgrade via roguelite mechanics to pay off a $100M debt. But repayment isn't freedom. Hack the system using meta-elements to expose a dystopian megacorp across 7 distinct endings!
